class: organizer gate defect. The risk unit's behaviour is unchanged and has been in force since before activation, including throughout the readiness field; only the check that validates its declaration was wrong.
defect: The evaluator validated a team's risk policy against an inline dictionary in cli.py naming policy id cup50v2-common-risk-unit-v1. The shipped policy is cup50v2-common-risk-unit-exante-v1, written when the realised-volatility risk unit was replaced by the ex-ante one. The two drifted at that moment and no charged trial could ever pass; the charged path was unreachable for the whole research phase.
evidence: team-12 official-seed-001 registered and evaluated successfully after the fix; ledger hash chain verifies; eight result artifacts written across three cost levels.
fix: The policy id moves into config.toml, where every other tunable already lives, and the evaluator checks the shipped policy against the config rather than against a copy of it. A test asserts the id is not inlined again. This is the same defect the config refactor exists to prevent -- a policy restated in a second place, and the second place going stale.
found_by: the organizer, on the first charged trial run for real
why_the_tests_missed_it: Every test either supplied the CLI's own expectation or bypassed _evaluate. The check was self-consistent and wrong, which no amount of internal consistency can detect. It surfaced on the first execution of the real path against the real artifact.
